capabilities.name: Job readiness packet
capabilities.summary: Before an order goes to the floor, the production or quality lead gets one packet: each requirement matched to its approved drawing, specification or inspection plan, with conflicting revisions, gaps and material shortfalls listed. The owners decide; nothing is approved or released.

capabilities.name: Production cost variance sheet
capabilities.summary: At period close the plant controller gets one sheet that separates material, labor and overhead differences from standard, by order and by product, with missing actuals and changed standards flagged. Each difference is a question for operations, never a cause.

capabilities.name: Production schedule rebuild
capabilities.summary: When orders or forecasts change, the production planner gets a draft build schedule from open orders, work-centre capacity and material availability, with every overload and shortage listed, not quietly fixed. The planner checks feasibility and approves the changes.

capabilities.name: RFQ clarification list
capabilities.summary: A buyer sending drawings and specifications out for quotation gets one list of missing details, conflicting revisions and ambiguous tolerances, and a record of each supplier's answers. The buyer approves every message; the engineer settles every technical question.

capabilities.name: Shipment documentation check
capabilities.summary: When a job finishes, the shipping or quality lead gets one index comparing the order, the inspection records, the required certificates and the packing details, with each missing record and each quantity that does not agree set out. Nothing is certified or released.
